m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:きょうは ユミと こうえんで あそぶ。
entries.en: Today Yumi and I are spending the day at the park.

entries.anchor: m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:さんじ。ユミは まだ こない。
entries.en: Three o'clock. Yumi still doesn't come.

entries.anchor: m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:てがみは にちようびだ。
m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:ぼくは えきで ユミを まつ。
entries.en: I wait for Yumi at the station.

entries.anchor: m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:ぼくは にじに えきに いく。
entries.en: I go to the station at two.

m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:ぼくは ニュースを みる。
m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:ぼくは ユミの てがみを もういちど みる。
entries.en: I look at Yumi's letter one more time.

entries.anchor: m11/story:ja-m11-two-oclock-at-the-station/ja:よじ。ユミは まだ こない。
entries.en: Four o'clock. Yumi still doesn't come.
